scope: Experimental1213o on 1213n (#43): native NPC catalog reads run on a worker thread. The host relevance scan (every 2 s) and the client Hello binds request a catalog from the worker and take the finished snapshot on the engine thread; each NPC about to be bound is re-read and compared on the engine thread (freshNpcCatalogEntry) before bindNpcChannel. Without a current snapshot a client Hello is deferred while the worker reads. NPC stream status adds catalogStale and worker requests/completed/failed/last/max ms. Take 1235f (1213n): the host scan still stalled the engine thread 80-207 ms.
